title: Regulatory gate sync & cross-evidence stitching for identity & audit controls
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Deliver a synchronized milestone calendar and an "evidence stitching" process that ensures SSO/SAML configuration changes and audit-log retention proofs are captured, correlated, and exportable for SOC2/ISO evidence packages.

Scope:
- Define a minimal evidence schema for identity and audit controls (items required for audits: SSO configuration snapshots, SAML metadata, SSO test results, authz RBAC mapping snapshots, audit-log retention proofs, ingestion pipeline checks).
- Implement orchestration that ties each compliance gate to concrete artifacts and owners (owner, storage location, TTL, verification step, automation hooks).
- Build a lightweight dashboard and runbook pointers in Console to show gate status and last-evidence timestamp.
- Create a cross-team release checklist and fallbacks for rolling back identity-related changes during cutovers.

Key trade-offs considered:
- Strict automation vs. lightweight manual verification: we favor automated evidence collection for flags that can be reliably captured (SAML metadata, audit-log retention metrics) and a short manual checklist for human-reviewed items (policy narratives).
- Retention costs vs. audit defensibility: to minimize cost we keep high-fidelity raw logs for a short window (30d) and curated summaries/artifacts for long-term retention (up to 1yr), with a documented process for extending retention on customer request.

Deliverables / Milestones:
1) Evidence schema v1 + mapping doc (owner: Security PM) — 2025-02-20
2) Automation hooks: SSO metadata snapshot job & SAML test harness (owner: ENG infra) — 2025-03-10
3) Audit-log retention proof exporter & verification lambda (owner: ENG logging) — 2025-03-24
4) Console gate dashboard + runbook links (owner: Console PM/Design) — 2025-04-01
5) Dry run: internal compliance review + evidence bundle generation (owner: Legal/Security) — 2025-04-07
6) Public rollout and doc publish (customer-facing) — 2025-04-15

Stakeholders: Security (lead), Infra Eng, Console PM & Design, Legal, Customer Success (for enterprise customers needing extended retention).

Risks and mitigations: 
- Risk: SSO changes deployed without evidence capture. Mitigation: pre-deploy webhook that flags any SSO config change and creates a blocking checklist item in the gate pipeline until snapshot is captured.
- Risk: Evidence mismatch across systems (e.g., RBAC snapshot vs. audit entries). Mitigation: add correlation keys (deployment id, timestamp, operator) to each artifact; include automated consistency checks in the verification job.
